title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Five-PR mirror-gaps sequence (0156) underway. P1 IMPLEMENTED, COMMITTED, GREEN at 7b8acd2 on test/mirror-census-closure, orchestrator-verified - but UNPUSHED, no PR, coverage entry unwritten. P0 (track the plan, 0158) ruled, unimplemented. P2 re-scoped SMALLER than the plan's 115-line estimate: 0159 strikes H-C, 0160 keeps the H-A veto, leaving H-B plus veto naming/logging plus the A1 extraction. P3-P5 conditional. Nothing pushed or merged; main still 1bb149d.
spine.next_step: START HERE. open_risks: P1 is committed but UNPUSHED (7b8acd2, test/mirror-census-closure). Invisible to CI and to a fresh clone; a branch cut off main will not carry it. Push it first or the census is absent from every later PR's baseline.

Plan section 9's monotone-forward receipt row is MISWORDED - rewrite before P2 (0160). It demands a test red-on-parent BECAUSE the mitosis.js:3787 veto exists; that veto is the resurrection guard. Handing the row over verbatim ships a safety regression.
Plan section 7's LOC table is STALE for P2: ~115 production lines assumed a scope including H-C and an H-A rewrite, both removed by 0159 and 0160. Re-estimate; do not reuse the number.

METHOD RISK (0159): round one refuted H-C on a sole-caller claim one grep falsified - applyShipTransition has a second caller at mitosis.js:562, journal replay. Trace producers; never accept 'this has one caller'.

Spec 3.1 implemented LITERALLY is a SAFETY REGRESSION (0155): a total fact-assign resurrects condemned content, and gh pr list --limit 200 at mitosis.js:3718 means absence from the merged listing is not evidence of non-merge (0154).

.mitosis/run.json is operator-hand-editable (documented at mitosis.js:4410), so a hand-injected status shipped is reachable though no in-code path writes one. 0159 records this as an open TAMPER SURFACE, not closed, not in M2.

P3-P5 are CONDITIONAL - re-confirm the justifying milestone still names the region before opening each. If M3 deletes runReconcileOnlyAdvance rather than absorbing it, P4 shrinks to a characterization test with no extraction.

M3's 'shepherd path' has TWO referents: the leases.mjs poll shepherd (mirrored), and runReconcileOnlyAdvance, which log strings at mitosis.js:3009/3011/3020/3031 name 'reconcile-only shepherd'. Settle before planning M3.

Spec anchors pin to 450804e, +68 to +81 off against main. Re-derive by execution; NEVER copy a spec line number (0148). The plan's own 1bb149d anchors verified clean on every one checked this session.
0152 generalized: treat EVERY enumeration and absolute claim in the quiescent-advance spec as UNVERIFIED until executed. Section 8's 22-to-14 arithmetic is STILL not re-derived.

Section 10's mirror-twin gotcha list is WRONG for a third MSP. From 0159: mitosis.js's applyRunDelta/foldRunManifest at :560-593 mirror run-log.mjs and are called by nothing in mitosis.js; the live fold is the fold-run-log.mjs CLI. Not dead code - do not delete.

Every PR needs a docs/invariants/coverage/*.json entry verdicting ALL 12 registry ids, ADDED in its own diff. The gate reads COMMITTED history, not the index. Piping the gate to tail MASKS its exit code - capture it directly.
The coverage gate checks row SHAPE, never the truth of a check string, so the entry stays orchestrator-authored per 0143.
NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL AGENTS. mitosis.js is read as TEXT only - held by both subagents this session.
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.

The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (now 1788, up from 1766). ALWAYS redirect and read only the tail, matching the node reporter's info-prefixed summary lines. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.
A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141). Titles cap at 72 chars. Merge stays human-gated.

P1-P5 must land SERIALLY, never in parallel worktrees (plan section 8) - they touch mitosis.js and each other's neighbourhoods, and a policed-twin edit must land in both copies in one commit. Parallelize investigation, never landing.

ALWAYS_DENIED's pinned realm surface runs in CI on every push and PR while node-version floats at 26.x, so a Node minor adding a global halts the gate. Fail-closed by design (0140); classify the name, do NOT pin Node.
12 leaked worktrees / ~78MB remain live; the reaper verb does not exist. The tree carries five pre-existing dirty paths - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
